summary: Output format enforcement + input validation guidance + smart extraction to fix format non-compliance and incomplete-input assumption failures

edits.hypothesis: Making the system prompt explicit about output format compliance (ANSWER: prefix, no markdown) and input validation requirements will guide the model to follow format specs exactly and detect incomplete input before processing
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The mechanism is instructional; the model needs explicit guidance on what format compliance means, when to validate input, and how to report incompleteness rather than guess
edits.trigger_condition: Always; the system prompt applies to all tasks
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) evolve-logic-002 would output plain answer if prompted; evolve-ledger-003 would detect truncation if told to validate first; (preservative) logic reasoning and constraint-satisfaction strategies are preserved by framing guidance around foundational problem-solving, not changing the actual approach; (transfer) input validation and format compliance are general practices that apply to all future task families (business-day scheduling, text transformations, etc.)
edits.regression_risk: Low; guidance is additive and task-agnostic. Existing good behaviors (constraint anchoring, systematic testing) are preserved.
edits.mechanism: Making the system prompt explicit about output format compliance (ANSWER: prefix, no markdown) and input validation requirements will guide the model to follow format specs exactly and detect incomplete input before processing

edits.hypothesis: Implementing smart extraction that detects 'ANSWER:' prefix and removes markdown formatting (**word** → word) will recover the intended answer even when the model adds explanation or formatting, enabling correct extraction and grading
edits.targets_mode: output_format_non_compliance; extraction mechanism failure despite correct reasoning
edits.why_not_lower_lever: This is an information-routing and plumbing problem (how to parse and clean the model's text output); a prompt-only fix doesn't ensure extraction works when the model still wraps answers in markdown or explanatory sentences; extraction logic must handle the de facto output format
edits.trigger_condition: Triggers when the final line contains markdown (e.g., **Sawyer** owns the rabbit.) or ANSWER: prefix; fallback to cleaned last line otherwise
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) evolve-logic-002 output '**Sawyer** owns the rabbit.' would be cleaned to 'Sawyer' by markdown removal; (preservative) success cases (e.g., evolve-logic-006) that already format correctly are unaffected; (transfer) markdown removal is format-agnostic and will work on any task type
edits.regression_risk: Very low; extraction only cleans, never manufactures content. If the last line is already clean, it passes through unchanged.
edits.mechanism: Implementing smart extraction that detects 'ANSWER:' prefix and removes markdown formatting (**word** → word) will recover the intended answer even when the model adds explanation or formatting, enabling correct extraction and grading

edits.hypothesis: Adding explicit instructions in the task template footer that format will be extracted from the last line reinforces output format compliance expectation without being task-specific, making the requirement salient to the model
edits.why_not_lower_lever: This is a prompt-level anchor that makes the extraction contract visible to the model at task time; it's placed in the task context (not system-wide) so it applies to every task without modification
edits.trigger_condition: Always; appended to every task after question substitution
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) evolve-logic-002 would see the reminder and should format the final answer more carefully; (preservative) does not override task-specific format instructions (e.g., 'Answer with name only'); it merely reinforces that the last line is extracted; (transfer) applies equally to all task families
edits.regression_risk: Minimal; it is a factual statement about the grading mechanism, not a constraint on reasoning.
edits.mechanism: Adding explicit instructions in the task template footer that format will be extracted from the last line reinforces output format compliance expectation without being task-specific, making the requirement salient to the model

mechanism: Output format enforcement + input validation guidance + smart extraction to fix format non-compliance and incomplete-input assumption failures
